title: Concept: Ktor exception class in a response
description: A Ktor exception with its internal package path in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The class names the engine and the failing feature, which tells an attacker which serialisation or routing plugin is in the request path.
applicability: Deployments that render a Ktor exception with its internal package path into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The class names the engine and the failing feature, which tells an attacker which serialisation or routing plugin is in the request path.
